en.headline: 10,000 civil servants take part in Huanggang port stress test
en.dek: The third major readiness exercise at the new Hong Kong Port Area tests full boundary clearance procedures, e-channels and vehicle booths ahead of the facility’s opening.
body: About 10,000 civil servants are taking part in a large-scale stress test at the Hong Kong Port Area of the new Huanggang port on Saturday, according to the Security Bureau.

Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the exercise is the third in a series of readiness tests and the first to trial several new border-clearance technologies, including collaborative e-channel systems for joint inspection with Shenzhen counterparts.

The scale represents a 20 per cent increase over the historical peak hourly clearance volume of about 7,700 people. Organisers also arranged for close to 1,000 vehicles to test the joint vehicle clearance checkpoints under simulated peak conditions.

Earlier drills focused more narrowly on the public transport interchange. A further large exercise is scheduled for 29 August. The government has said the port will open once systems are fully commissioned and cross-boundary stress tests are completed satisfactorily.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸港方區周六壓力測試 萬名公務員參與
zh.dek: 新皇崗口岸港方口岸區第三場大型演練測試全面通關流程、電子通道及車輛檢查亭，為口岸啟用作準備。
body: 保安局表示，約一萬名公務員周六參與新皇崗口岸港方口岸區大型壓力測試。
保安局局長鄧炳強指，這是系列準備工作中的第三場演練，亦是首次試用多項新通關技術，包括與深圳方面協作的電子通道聯檢系統。
演練規模較歷史最高每小時通關量約7,700人次高出兩成。主辦單位亦安排接近1,000輛車輛測試聯合車輛檢查亭，模擬高峰情況。
早前演練較集中於公共運輸交匯處。當局已計劃8月29日再舉行大型演練。政府表示，待系統全面裝備及跨境壓力測試順利完成後，口岸可盡早啟用。
